submitted.rationale: AgSbO3 (pyrochlore/perovskite-type, Sb fraction 0.5) is the only ternary phase near mid-line and a known visible-light absorber (~2.6 eV gap, under the 2.7 eV illumination). EQE measured: idx4 (0.35) 0.23%, idx8 (0.468) 0.94%, idx9 (0.52) 0.89%, idx10 (0.56) 0.52%, idx15 (0.73) 0.30%. The peak sits at the AgSbO3 stoichiometry, possibly slightly Ag-rich, and idx8 is the highest measured.
